    * No new sensory deficit.
    * No new cranial nerve deficit identified.
* Cerebellar assessment: Assess coordination, dysmetria, nystagmus and gait when clinically appropriate, particularly given the previous posterior fossa pathology.
* Symptoms of raised ICP: Assess for headache, nausea, vomiting, visual disturbance, reduced level of consciousness or worsening neurological status.
* Hydrocephalus: Continue monitoring clinically and correlate with the latest neuroimaging.
* Surgical wound: Previous posterior fossa wound assessed for erythema, swelling, discharge, CSF leakage or evidence of infection.
* Shunt preparation: Patient planned for CSF diversion/shunt surgery tomorrow; ensure required preoperative investigations and imaging have been reviewed.

12. Plan: Proceed with the planned CSF diversion/shunt surgery tomorrow once preoperative assessment and investigations are satisfactory.
